name: Filmora AI
tagline: Wondershare Filmora is a consumer video editor packed with AI tools including smart cutout, AI portrait, motion tracking, noise removal, and an AI text-based editor that edits video by editing its transcript. It targets YouTubers, vloggers, and social-media creators who want professional results without steep learning curves.
